leads.title: Atomism in the Vaisheshika school of India
leads.why: A theory of eternal atoms combining in pairs and triads became a standing position in Indian philosophy, argued over by Nyaya, Jain and Buddhist schools for more than a thousand years.
leads.verify: The date of the Vaisheshika Sutra is very uncertain; report the range scholars defend. State the case for and against Greek influence, and change origin to unknown if the dispute is live.
search: Vaisheshika Sutra Kanada date atomism paramanu
Indian atomism Greek influence independent debate

leads.title: Radioactivity discovered in Paris
leads.why: Spontaneous radiation from uranium, then polonium and radium, showed atoms could change, and led to nuclear physics, radiometric dating, radiotherapy and nuclear energy.
leads.verify: Date Becquerel's uranium observations (February-March 1896), the Curies' polonium and radium (1898) and the transmutation theory of Rutherford and Soddy in Montreal (1902), which may merit its own record.
search: Becquerel 1896 uranium rays discovery Comptes rendus
Rutherford Soddy 1902 cause and nature of radioactivity transmutation

leads.title: Elixir alchemy in Han and Jin China
leads.why: The search for elixirs built up a body of practice with mercury, sulphur, arsenic and saltpetre that produced gunpowder and much of Chinese mineral chemistry.
leads.verify: Confirm the earliest record (Li Shaojun at the court of Han Wudi), the disputed date of the Cantong qi, and Ge Hong's Baopuzi (c. 320 CE). State the evidence that it arose independently of Mediterranean alchemy.

leads.title: Structural theory of organic compounds
leads.why: Four-valent carbon linking into chains and rings let chemists design molecules, and synthetic dyes, drugs and polymers followed.
leads.verify: Date Kekule's and Couper's 1858 papers, Butlerov's 1861 statement of chemical structure and the benzene ring (1865), and settle how credit is divided.
search: Couper 1858 new chemical theory structural formulae

leads.title: Land and climate change inferred from fossils and landforms in Song China
leads.why: Marine shells in mountain cliffs, river silt and buried bamboo were read as proof that coastlines, mountains and climate had changed, centuries before similar reasoning in Europe.
leads.verify: Locate the passages in the Dream Pool Essays (Taihang cliffs, Yandang mountains, Yanzhou bamboo) and their dates. Check for any later use of the idea in China, and note the earlier comparable reasoning of Ibn Sina (c. 1027) and of Greek writers, one of which may be the first_known origin.

leads.title: Deep time read from the rocks in Enlightenment Scotland
leads.why: An Earth shaped by slow cycles of erosion, deposition and uplift over immense time became the frame for geology, and gave Darwin the time evolution required.
leads.verify: Date the 1785 reading, the 1788 paper, the Siccar Point visit and the 1795 book. Record Steno's 1669 principles of strata as a precursor and Lyell's Principles (1830-33) and William Smith's 1815 map as what followed; stratigraphy by fossils may merit its own record.
search: Hutton 1788 Theory of the Earth Transactions Royal Society of Edinburgh

concepts.name: Atomism
concepts.summary: Holding that all matter is built from minute indivisible particles whose combinations explain the variety of things.

concepts.name: Geological change and deep time
concepts.summary: Reading rocks, fossils and landforms as the record of slow natural change over very long spans of time.

concepts.name: Laboratory alchemy and distillation
concepts.summary: Transforming, separating and purifying substances with dedicated apparatus for distilling, subliming and calcining, pursued as a systematic art with written recipes and theory.

concepts.name: Radioactivity
concepts.summary: Knowing that some atoms spontaneously emit radiation and change into other elements.

concepts.name: Structural theory of organic chemistry
concepts.summary: Representing a compound by the way its atoms are bonded to each other, so that its properties and synthesis can be predicted.
